summary: P0 Frontend Fixes Verified - (1) Quotation Rate input 2-decimal persistence working correctly, (2) PO print template navy header, HSN width, and font family all verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 fixes verified: (1) RateInput component in CRMPage.js now normalizes stored value to 2 decimals on blur via toFixed(2), so '100' becomes '100.00' and persists across re-focus/re-render. (2) PO print template in PrintDialogs.js has navy (#1D3557) header background with white text, HSN column at 11% width, and Helvetica Neue/Arial 11px font family.

RATE-1.details: Type '12500' in Rate field, blur → displays '12,500.00' (comma-formatted). Re-focus → shows '12500.00' (2-decimal normalized value, NOT '12500'). Basic Amt and Total columns calculate correctly.

RATE-2.details: Type '100' in Rate field, blur → displays '100.00'. Re-focus → shows '100.00' (2-decimal persistence confirmed).

RATE-3.details: Empty Rate input stays empty when blurred (no '0.00' on empty).

PO-PRINT-1.details: PO print template items table header has NAVY (#1D3557 / rgb(29,53,87)) background with WHITE (rgb(255,255,255)) text - verified via computed styles inspection.

PO-PRINT-2.details: HSN column width set to 11% in colWidthMap (line 242 of PrintDialogs.js). HSN data (84818090) displays correctly in preview.

PO-PRINT-3.details: Body text uses 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif font family at 11px (line 163 of PrintDialogs.js baseStyles).
